# Pioneer Scout's Uncharted Lands Challenge - August 2024

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jul 13, 2024
- 3 min read

Updated: Aug 5, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9fa259fef063445ea6615c98ad79c78d~mv2.png)

The Pioneer Scout's Uncharted Lands Challenge is a limited-time event in Fallout 76.

On the 6th of August at 12pm US EST (Atom Shop changeover), you will be able to claim the Marshal Mallow T-Shirt & Shorts for free from the Atom Shop.

Have this outfit equipped and complete several challenges to unlock limited-time rewards.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e32f0b7a8a5649c2813500c687775053~mv2.jpg)

__FAQ__

**Can I complete these challenges in Power Armour?**

No. When you are in Power Armour, the game removes your clothes and body armour so it won't register that you are wearing the outfit.

**I don't have a Camera, where can I find one?**

**Can we re-roll the challenges?**

No.

**What happens if I don't complete 5 out of 5 challenges each week?**

You are out of luck and won't be able to unlock the end reward. Sorry.

**Can I complete these challenges on a custom server?**

No.

**Can I complete these challenges on a private server, by myself?**

Yes.

**Can I complete these challenges in one day?**

Yes. All the challenges for the week will be released on the first day, allowing you a week to complete them.

__Daily Challenges and Rewards__

__Week 1__

**Challenge 1**

Take a Camera Picture of a "Lost" while wearing the Marshal Mallow T-Shirt & Shorts.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a9d2b02732464caf9a50d5f3b9619dd0~mv2.jpg)

**Fixed Lost spawns:**

Dark Hollow Manor

Research Site Rhineland

Slumber Mill Motel (at the Red Rocket on the left)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_439e1f7ffff44a27a0a3141f52937bd9~mv2.jpg)

**Tip**

Taking a photo of a dead Lost will also count towards this challenge.

**Reward**

Scout's Banner

**Challenge 2**

Take a Camera Picture at the Slumber Mill Motel while wearing the Marshal Mallow T-Shirt & Shorts.

**Location:**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_226a017a550d44359628676578661c74~mv2.jpg)

**Reward**

3x Lunchboxes

**Challenge 3**

Deploy a C.A.M.P. within the Skyline Valley Region while wearing the Marshal Mallow T-Shirt & Shorts.

**Skyline Valley Region**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d970a298ec354027846dffecb82459a7~mv2.jpg)

**Tip:**

You don't need to deploy a camp with your main character. You can use any of the five characters on your account to place their camp module in Skyline Valley, and it will still count towards the challenge.

**Reward**

3x Legendary Modules

**Challenge 4**

Collect 5x Purified Water while wearing the Marshal Mallow T-Shirt & Shorts.

**Tip:**

- Having Purified Water drop as a reward will count towards this challenge.
- Purchasing Purified Water from NPC and Player Vendors will count towards this challenge.
- Crafting Purified Water will count towards this challenge.

**Reward**

1x Nuka-Cola Mix Pack

**Challenge 5**

Cook 5x Meals (food buff items) in your C.A.M.P. while wearing the Marshal Mallow T-Shirt & Shorts.

**Reward**

3x Perk Card Packs

__Week 2__

**Challenge 1**

Take a Camera Picture at "Johnson's Acre" while wearing the Marshal Mallow T-Shirt & Shorts.

**Location:**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b5daab85603b4567b1d094a4e38dfced~mv2.jpg)

**Reward**

3x Lunchboxes

**Challenge 2**

Take a Camera Picture of an Ant while wearing the Marshal Mallow T-Shirt & Shorts.

**Tip**

Taking a photo of a dead Rad Ant will also count towards this challenge.

**Reward**

Scout's Banner

**Challenge 3**

Collect 2x RadAway while wearing the Marshal Mallow T-Shirt & Shorts.

**Tip:**

- Having RadAway or RadAway Diluted drop as a reward will count towards this challenge.
- Purchasing RadAway or RadAway Diluted from NPC and Player Vendors will count towards this challenge.
- Crafting RadAway or RadAway Diluted will count towards this challenge.

**Reward**

1x Nuka-Cola Mix Pack

**Challenge 4**

Eat 5x Cooked Meals while wearing the Marshal Mallow T-Shirt & Shorts.

**Reward**

3x Legendary Modules

**Challenge 5**

Kill 2x Thrashers while wearing the Marshal Mallow T-Shirt & Shorts.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f038c63083794bf5983405bb930acf68~mv2.jpg)

**Fixed Thrasher spawn locations:**

Naked Creek

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a3c4dd43155547468d3b875a2402aa4f~mv2.jpg)

**Reward**

3x Perk Card Packs

__Weekly Challenges and Rewards__

Image credit: __SugarBombs.RADS__

**Week 1**

Complete 5 out of 5 challenges

**Reward**

"I'd Rather Be Camping" Poster

A poster to express your true feelings while you're not exploring the great outdoors!

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0a85e910f50c4ce38f21bfc41ddfd3a5~mv2.jpg)

**Week 2**

Complete 5 out of 5 challenges

**Reward**

Marshal Mellow Figure

A cute figure to brighten up your C.A.M.P. with!

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a0a8a01521bd436484ad6e75b8c48741~mv2.jpg)

**Complete week 1 and week 2 challenges**

**Reward**

Marshal Mallow Roasting Stick Weapon Skin.

It can poke wieners, marshmallows, and your enemies all in one!

- SKIN IS CRAFTABLE AT WEAPON WORKBENCHES. -

- Works with most 1h melee weapons. -

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_322c60832ddb4e6aa6c775509c5547dc~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)
